keyFindings.description: onAuthenticated still makes the editor writable at once (callbacks.onAdmission -> ProofDocument.tsx:530 setReadOnly), but since 988beb33 the pending sync learns of the writable admission only in notifyAdmitted, after SyncStep2. In that gap PendingSync.readOnly is still true, so onUpdate skips record(): typing after a read-only-to-writable reconnect and before its sync is sent but never stored, and every later stored row depends on it (another tab drops it as rebuilt history). Hand the read-only flag to the pending sync synchronously at authentication and defer only the restore/prune to the gate.
